title: Grateful Dead Live at Baltimore Civic Center on 1982-04-19
lineage: SBD Master Cassette > R1 7.5ips 1/4 track > Technics RS-1506 > Grace designs Lunatec V3 (pre only) > Korg MR-1000 > DSD-DFF 1bit 5.64 Mhz > Audio Gate SW > 24/96 WAV

ai_review.summary: Audience tape of the famed Raven space show with Phil Lesh absent and a mid‑song cutoff, offering limited sound quality.
ai_review.review: The recording captures the legendary Raven Space performance, but it is an audience source that suffers from a noticeable dropout in the middle of "Good Lovin'". Reviewers note that Phil Lesh missed the previous night, which affects the band’s usual dynamics, and the overall audio fidelity is modest at best.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one brief review with a zero‑star rating; shows historical interest but poor recording due to cutoff and missing bassist, leading to a low overall assessment.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audience tape with ambient crowd noise; cuts out in the middle of "Good Lovin'", limiting continuity. No comments on clarity beyond this issue.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Mentioned discussion among tapers about an ideal second‑set set list, but no specific flow commentary.

band_member_comments.Phil: Phil Lesh was absent the night before, noted as a drawback.
